name: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver
summary: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is a night elf sentinel stationed at the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She is deeply troubled by the disappearance of Priestess Velinde Starsong and dispatches trusted Alliance adventurers to track down clues regarding her whereabouts. Through her inquiries, she seeks to piece together the unraveling mystery behind the Scythe of Elune.

sections.title: A Sentinel's Inquest
sections.body: Standing watch over Darnassus from the Warrior's Terrace, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver represents the vigilant military arm of the kaldorei. When Priestess Velinde Starsong mysteriously vanished without leaving word, Thyn'tel refused to let the trail go cold. Sensing that grave forces were involved, she takes it upon herself to commission adventurers willing to dig into the priestess's personal belongings and uncover where her journey led.

sections.title: Tracing Velinde's Steps
sections.body: Thyn'tel directs investigators to inspect Velinde's remaining effects left behind in the capital. The clues uncovered reveal a journal describing Velinde's communion with Elune and the terrifying worgen beasts summoned through the Scythe of Elune. Guided by Thyn'tel, travelers follow the trail southward through the port of Ratchet into the Barrens, attempting to find where the desperate priestess sailed before she vanished entirely.

faq.answer: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is a night elf sentinel located on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. She serves as a quest giver initiating the investigation into the disappearance of Priestess Velinde Starsong.

faq.q: Where can I find Thyn'tel Bladeweaver?
faq.answer: She can be found standing in Darnassus, specifically stationed on the Warrior's Terrace among the kaldorei warriors and sentinels.

faq.q: What quests does Thyn'tel Bladeweaver offer?
faq.answer: She is the primary contact for the quest chain investigating Velinde Starsong, providing quests such as 'Velinde's Effects', 'The Barrens Port', and concluding with 'Answered Questions'.

faq.q: Why is she interested in Velinde Starsong?
faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a priestess who served in Ashenvale until she disappeared abruptly, leaving her work unfinished. Thyn'tel seeks to discover her fate and uncover the dark mystery surrounding her departure.

faq.q: Where does her quest chain lead?
faq.answer: After examining Velinde's effects in Darnassus, Thyn'tel directs investigators south across the sea to Ratchet in the Barrens to track down shipping records of Velinde's voyage.

faq.q: Is Thyn'tel Bladeweaver an Alliance-only contact?
faq.answer: Yes. Stationed within the night elf capital of Darnassus, Thyn'tel Bladeweaver offers quests exclusively to members of the Alliance.

angles.text: For night elves, Thyn'tel's assignment strikes close to home, uncovering the hidden tragedy of a revered priestess who fell victim to forces beyond her control.
Alliance heroes who visit the Warrior's Terrace are entrusted by Thyn'tel to venture deep into neutral and contested territory to uncover the truth.
Positioned right among the trainers on the Warrior's Terrace, Thyn'tel is a familiar sentinel face to Alliance warriors passing through Darnassus.
